---
name: Feature Request / 功能请求
about: Suggest an idea for this project / 为这个项目提出想法
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 功能描述 / Feature Description
<!-- 简要描述你想要的功能 / A clear and concise description of what you want to happen -->

## 问题描述 / Problem Statement
<!-- 这个功能解决什么问题？ / What problem does this feature solve? -->

## 建议的解决方案 / Proposed Solution
<!-- 描述你希望如何实现这个功能 / Describe how you'd like this feature to work -->

## 替代方案 / Alternatives Considered
<!-- 你是否考虑过其他解决方案？ / Have you considered any alternative solutions? -->

## 附加信息 / Additional Context
<!-- 添加任何其他有关功能请求的信息或截图 / Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here -->

## 优先级 / Priority
<!-- 这个功能对你有多重要？ / How important is this feature to you? -->
- [ ] 必需 / Must have
- [ ] 很想要 / Nice to have
- [ ] 可有可无 / Optional
